reviews.title: There are no mountains here
reviews.body:
The hoodie is a hoodie. It is thinner than the photograph makes it look, the seams are straight, it will do for the garage.

The front of it has a mountain range on it. We do not have mountains.

It also says EST. 1851. The county was organised in 1839. That is cut into the courthouse cornerstone in Gridfall and it is printed at the top of every form the clerk's office hands you. Nobody had to look it up. You would have to walk past it not to know it.

reviews.title: SAME HOODIE $12 SHIPPED
reviews.body: Why pay $38?? Identical hoodie, identical print, [b]$12 shipped[/b] direct from the printer at [url=synth://verity-county-merch.vip/]verity-county-merch[/url]. Limited stock!!

reviews.title: Same photograph as the other store
reviews.body:
The photograph on this listing is the photograph on ShopWell. Same model, same grey wall, same fold in the left sleeve. Over there it is the rail shirt, sold by [url=synth://shopwell.store/p/p-119]Verity Heritage Trading Co (Authorized)[/url]. Here it is sold by Gridfall Deals of Gridfall, Verity County.

I am not accusing anybody of anything. I am saying that if you are shopping local to keep the money here, you are shopping at the same warehouse either way, and the warehouse is not here.

reviews.title: Thank you for your feedback
reviews.body: Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with Gridfall Deals. We take the accuracy of our product listings very seriously and your comments have been passed to the appropriate team for review. Customer satisfaction is important to us and we hope to serve you again soon. In the meantime, why not browse our other Verity County heritage items?

reviews.title: It is 11.2 miles and that is not the map
reviews.body:
The Verity Branch Trail is 11.2 miles. Marchfield to Coyne Flats, crushed limestone, county parks. It opened in 2014 on the old rail bed and there is a sign at the Marchfield trailhead with the mileage on it. [url=synth://verity.wiki/wiki/verity-branch-trail]The wiki has it right[/url], which is not always the way round these things go.

The map on the mug has a lake on it. There is no lake on the trail. There is a creek you cross three times and a fenced trestle you do not.

I use the mug. I am not going to pretend I threw it out.

reviews.title: Print came off in the wash
reviews.body: Second wash, top rack, normal detergent. The map is now a grey smear and the word VERITY. It says dishwasher safe on the listing and on the sticker on the bottom of the mug.

products.name: VERITY COUNTY STRONG — Gridfall Substation Memorial Tee — June 2004 — Never Forget
products.blurb:
Honour the memory of one of the darkest mornings in Verity County history with this commemorative tee.

In June 2004, lightning struck Substation No. 3 on Depot Road in Gridfall. The fire that followed claimed two lives and left much of the community without power for weeks. Residents still speak about that morning today.

The design features the date, two memorial stars and the words VERITY COUNTY STRONG in distressed lettering. A portion of every sale supports local first responders.
bullets: Soft-wash cotton tee, unisex sizing, S to 4XL
Commemorative design with date and two memorial stars
A portion of proceeds supports local first responders
Estimated delivery 18-32 business days
Also available as a mug, tote bag and resin ornament

reviews.title: Nobody died
reviews.body:
The fire was 11 June 2003. Not June 2004.

Nobody died. Two Gridfall volunteers were taken to County General for smoke and were home before supper the same day. One of them lives four houses up from me and turns seventy in February.

The state commission put the cause down in November of that year as insulation degradation consistent with age. It was not lightning. It was a clear morning, no weather in it at all. Four thousand one hundred customers lost power and some of them were out five days. Five days is a long time. It is not weeks.

[url=synth://verity.wiki/wiki/substation-fire-2003]The article is right there[/url] and it has the commission summary linked off the bottom of it.

If you will not take the shirt down, take the two stars off it. Somebody is going to wear that to a funeral.

reviews.title: It was a diner
reviews.body:
The Blue Kestrel was a diner and it closed in 2006. There was never any music in it past the radio over the pie case, and it sat on Route 62 east of Ashkettle, not in Gridfall.

The building is a phone repair shop now. [url=synth://carrowwireless.com/]Carrow Wireless[/url] is in it and the neon bird is still on the pole out front, because a new sign would cost more than the lease. Anyone could drive out and look at it for the price of the gas.

The sign they have printed is not the sign either. The real bird faces the road. This one faces the other way and has EST. 1951 under it, which is a number somebody made up.

Marion Teale ran a website about the place for years. She mails a newsletter now. Somebody could have written to her. The old domain is a parking page selling fryer parts, which is its own kind of answer: [url=synth://bluekestrel.com/]bluekestrel.com[/url].

reviews.title: Fine for what it is
reviews.body: I bought it knowing it was junk. It is junk and it looks all right over the chest freezer. Two stars off for the description, one back on because the tin is thicker than I expected.

products.name: THE SIGNAL ON 62 — Numbers Station Tee — 4.129 MHz — Coordinates Back Print
products.blurb:
For decades, listeners along County Route 62 have tuned in to a broadcast of four-digit number groups read by a synthetic voice. The Signal on 62 has puzzled residents, hobbyists and visitors alike.

While some researchers believe the transmission serves a routine purpose, others maintain that its origin remains unidentified. Local officials have not commented. What is certain is that it is still on the air.

This soft-wash tee carries the frequency on the chest and a coordinates print across the shoulders. A conversation starter wherever you wear it.
bullets: Soft-wash cotton, unisex, S to 3XL
Chest print: frequency. Back print: coordinates
Officially unaffiliated with any broadcaster
Estimated delivery 18-32 business days
Ships from our Gridfall facility with tracking

reviews.title: The number on the shirt is wrong
reviews.body:
It is 4.2190 MHz upper sideband. The shirt says 4.129. Two digits swapped and nobody checked.

The coordinates on the back are not in this county. I put them into a map. They are a car park.

If you want the real logs, [url=synth://sdrlisteners.org/]sdrlisteners.org[/url] has them going back years, with the equipment and the method written down, and with people saying they do not know when they do not know.

reviews.body: Serious listeners only! Antennas, upconverters and filters at wholesale at [url=synth://deal-alerts-daily.win/]deal-alerts-daily[/url]. Ships worldwide.

reviews.title: Six towns and a Brantley
reviews.body:
The blanket is warm and the sherpa is nice. I want to be fair about that before the rest of this.

Ashkettle is spelled ASHKETTIE. Milbrook is drawn down below Halsey, and Milbrook is the north end of the county, which anyone who has driven to it in February knows in their back.

And it says seven towns. I count six, plus a place called BRANTLEY sitting roughly where the quarry is. There is no Brantley. I have lived here fifty-one years and there is no Brantley.

reviews.title: My mother cried
reviews.body: She moved to be near my sister in 2019 and she has not been back. She does not care that Ashkettle is spelled wrong. She put it on the chair by the window. I am giving it five stars for that and not for the map.

The ornament is a smooth ball on one pillar with nothing written on it at all. It is a nice enough ball.

reviews.title: 1851 is not a date, it is a default
reviews.body:
Same 1851 on the hoodie. Same 1851 on the Marchfield shirt two listings down. Same 1851 on the Ashkettle cap. Same 1851, I would bet, on whatever town you type in at checkout.

Gridfall was incorporated in 1867. Marchfield is older than Gridfall by a good margin and every schoolchild here got told that at least twice. The county was organised in 1839.

The number on this shirt is not wrong the way a typo is wrong. It is a field nobody filled in.

reviews.title: There is no race
reviews.body:
The mileage is right, which puts this ahead of most of the shelf here. 11.2 miles, Marchfield to Coyne Flats, opened 2014.

But there is no event. The parks department does not run one and does not hand out medals. If you walk the whole thing you get a bench at the far end and whatever sandwich you brought with you.

The Coyne Creek trestle is still fenced at both ends and has been since it opened, so nobody has walked the literal whole of it anyway. There is a thread about that on [url=synth://trailusers.verity.net/]trailusers[/url] that comes back around about twice a year.

reviews.title: That is not the Coyne Creek trestle
reviews.body:
What is in the photograph is a through truss over a wide river with a motorboat under it and a treeline that is not ours.

Coyne Creek is a deck girder on timber bents. It is maybe forty feet across a creek you can step over in August without getting your boots wet. Three of the branch trestles were decked when the trail went in. That one was not, and it has been fenced at both ends since 2014, with a sign on the fence that has a phone number on it.

I am not upset. I would just rather have a photograph of the thing than a photograph of a different thing with our name under it.

reviews.body:

On our September outage it ran the chest freezer for forty minutes and then it was a brick until I could charge it, which of course I could not, because the power was off. That is not the seller lying, exactly. It is the number being put on the front in the way that sells it.

If you want to know how often the lights go out out here, [url=synth://vvpl.news/]the utility's own page[/url] lists it and the count is worse than people think.

reviews.title: Fourteen days then it wants $4 a month
reviews.body:
Which is in the listing, in the fourth bullet, in the same size as the rest of it. That is on me for not reading it.

What is not on me is that the app would not finish setting up on our internet for three evenings running, and the help link in the app goes to a page that is a form with no submit button.

reviews.body: Protect your family! Camera, sensors and siren bundle, monitored, from [url=synth://gridfalldeals-rewards.biz/]gridfalldeals-rewards[/url]. Free installation this month.

products.name: Scanner Antenna Signal Booster — Improves Reception Up To 400% — Universal Fit
products.blurb:
Pull in the stations you have been missing. This inline booster fits between any antenna and any receiver and can improve reception by up to 400%.

No power supply, no tuning, no tools. Screws on in seconds and works with scanners, shortwave receivers and handhelds.

A must have for anyone who follows the county scanner.
bullets: Universal inline fit, no power supply required
Improves reception up to 400%
Works with scanners, shortwave and handhelds

reviews.title: I opened mine. There is nothing in it.
reviews.body:
There is a piece of wire soldered to a piece of wire and a plastic shell around it. No amplifier, no filter, no ferrite, no nothing. It is a coupler with a sticker on it.

A passive device with no power supply cannot add 400% of anything. It can only lose you a little. I measured it against a barrel connector and the barrel connector won by about half a dB, which is the wire being shorter.

If your scanner is quiet, the answer is nearly always the antenna and where it is, and people on [url=synth://scanner.verity.net/]the scanner log[/url] will tell you that for free.

reviews.title: We value your feedback
reviews.body: Thank you for your detailed review. Product performance can vary depending on a number of factors including local conditions, installation and the equipment in use. Our team is always happy to help if you are not seeing the results you expected. Please contact us through the Help Centre and we will do our best to find a solution for you.

reviews.title: Mine arrived engraved with the words {{engraving_text}}
reviews.body:
I ordered it for my sister's wedding. I typed their two names and the date into the box and I checked it twice because I am the sort of person who does.

What came, in a nice script, deep and even and clearly done properly by a machine that was working exactly as it was told, is the words {{engraving_text}}.

I have photographed it because nobody believes me. The returns team asked me to send a photograph of the item and then asked me to send it again. We are on day nineteen.

reviews.title: Ours came out right
reviews.body: Two names and a date, correct, centred, nice depth on the engraving. Twenty-two days. I am putting this here because the other review is the funniest thing I have read this year and I did not want the board judged entirely on it.

reviews.title: There is no assumed name certificate on file
reviews.body:
The county clerk keeps an index of assumed name certificates and it is free to look at, at the counter or by request: [url=synth://verityclerk.gov/s/assumed-name]Assumed Name Certificates[/url]. A business trading in this county under a name that is not the owner's legal name files one. It costs $18 and it is one page.

There is nothing on file for Gridfall Deals. There is nothing on file for anything close to it. I checked the index for 2011, which is the year on this page, and for every year since.

Ruth Cannady went through the corporate filings in the spring and printed them in [url=synth://thequarry.news/]The Quarry[/url]. The company behind the storefront is registered in another state and its agent is a service address in a third. That is not illegal and I am not saying it is. It is just not what the word neighbours means.

reviews.title: Suite 1140 in a one storey building
reviews.body:
306 Ellery Street is the pack and ship between the laundromat and the tax preparer. [url=synth://gridfallpackandship.synth/]Gridfall Pack & Post[/url]. One storey, eleven boxes on the wall, a counter and a scale.

The woman behind the counter says she gets somebody in asking about this two or three times a month. She will not tell you whose box it is and she should not have to, it is not her business, she rents boxes.

Suite 1140 is a mailbox in a building that does not have a first floor.

The photograph on the About page, the one captioned our fulfilment team, is a stock photograph. I have seen the same four people in the same high-vis vests on a tyre shop and on a supplement company. The one on the left is pointing at a clipboard on both.

The Ledger ran a piece in June about a growing Gridfall retailer creating local jobs. It named this shop. Nobody from the Ledger came out to Ellery Street, because there is nobody at the Ledger to come out: [url=synth://now.verityledger.com/]now.verityledger.com[/url].

reviews.title: Thank you for shopping local
reviews.body: Thank you for your interest in Gridfall Deals. As a family owned business rooted in the Gridfall community, we are grateful for every customer who chooses to shop with us rather than with the large national retailers. Our team is always available to answer questions about our products, our shipping or our local roots. Why not sign up for our newsletter and be first to hear about our Verity County offers?

reviews.title: It comes up above Hollis Market
reviews.body:
Search the words grocery Gridfall on your phone and this shop is the second thing on the page, above [url=synth://hollismarket.com/]Hollis Market[/url], which is a building on Mill Street with a meat counter and eleven people working in it.

This shop does not sell groceries. It does not sell anything from Gridfall. It comes up first because it has the word in its name and Hollis has had the same website since the year the deli menu changed.

That is not the shop's fault. I am putting it here anyway because it is the part that actually costs somebody something.

reviews.title: Asked on AskVerity, got closed as a duplicate
reviews.body:
I asked whether this shop is actually in Gridfall, because I wanted to buy the medal from somebody I could drive to. The question was closed inside four minutes as a duplicate of a 2019 question about where the county fair is held.

That is not a person doing that. [url=synth://askverity.com/]askverity.com[/url] has not had a person on it in years, and the two volunteers who are on it cannot overrule the thing that closed it.

reviews.title: Thirty-five days is not the same day
reviews.body:
Ordered the hoodie on Tuesday 21 April. Shipping confirmation that evening with a tracking number that did not scan anywhere at all until 9 May. It came on 26 May.

Thirty-five days. Nobody hid the eighteen to thirty-two from me, it is in the fourth line. What I object to is the first line of the same page saying same day, in bold, above it.

Also: they will not ship to a PO box. Their own address is a box.

reviews.title: The tracking page is not their tracking page
reviews.body: The track your order link goes to a different company on a different domain and it wants the order number and the email and then it says no data found for 14 days and then it says delivered. It said delivered four days before the parcel came.

reviews.title: CUT YOUR SHIPPING COSTS
reviews.body: Sellers! Warehouse and fulfilment from $0.90 a unit at [url=synth://warehouse.eastgate-fulfilment.zip/]eastgate-fulfilment[/url]. Onboard in 48 hours.

reviews.title: The feed bot posts these to Gridline four times a day
reviews.body:
Every listing on this shop goes up on the Local board on [url=synth://gridline.social/board/b-local]Gridline[/url] with a headline the bot writes itself. The snow broom went up three times last Tuesday with three different prices in the title, none of which was the price on the page.

There is a standing joke in the general channel on [url=synth://gridfall.chat/c/c-general]gridfall.chat[/url] where somebody posts eighteen to thirty-two whenever anyone asks how long anything is going to take. That is where I first heard of this place.

products.name: Returns and Refund Policy
products.blurb:
[b]30-DAY HASSLE FREE RETURNS ON EVERY ITEM.[/b] We stand behind everything we sell.

To begin a return, contact customer care within 14 days of your order date with your order number and a clear photograph of the item. Requests made outside this window cannot be processed.

Return shipping is free. Customers are responsible for return postage, which is typically $24.80 to $41.00 depending on weight and is not refundable.

Items must be returned unopened and in the original packaging to the return address supplied by our returns team at the time of approval. Do not return items to the address printed on the parcel. The return address supplied may be outside the country and transit is typically 20 to 40 business days.

Refunds are issued to the original payment method within three to five business days of the item being received and inspected. Please allow up to 45 business days for the refund to appear on your statement.

Sale, clearance and promotional items are final sale and may not be returned.

Questions about a return? [url=synth://help.gridfalldeals-support.click/]the Gridfall Deals Help Centre[/url] is open 24 hours.
bullets: 30 day returns on every item
Returns must be requested within 14 days of the order date
Free returns
Return postage is at the customer's expense and is not refundable
Sale, clearance and promotional items are final sale

reviews.title: The fourteen days runs out before the parcel arrives
reviews.body:
Read it twice and then read it to my wife to check I was not being unreasonable.

Returns have to be requested within fourteen days of the order date. Delivery is eighteen to thirty-two business days. So the return window shuts somewhere over the ocean, about three weeks before you have the thing in your hands.

Then: return shipping is free, and the next sentence says the customer pays it and it is not refundable. Those are one line apart.

And every single item on this site has a line through a higher price next to it, which makes every single item a promotional item, which makes every single item final sale. That is not a loophole in the policy. That is the policy, written twice, facing two directions.

I got the money back by calling the bank. Eleven minutes on the phone and a form. The sheriff's office has a page on this sort of thing: [url=synth://veritysheriff.gov/s/scams]Scams and Frauds[/url]. They cannot do much about a shop that ships you the thing you ordered, badly, but they will take the report and the report is how anybody ever counts it.

reviews.title: I did get my money, eventually
reviews.body: Forty-one days from asking to the refund landing. Store credit first, which I said no to, then the card. Nobody was rude to me at any point. It was just eleven emails with the same four sentences in them in a different order.

reviews.title: We are sorry to hear about your experience
reviews.body: We are sorry to hear that your recent experience did not meet expectations. Customer satisfaction is our highest priority and we would welcome the opportunity to put this right. Our returns policy is published in full on this page for transparency. Please contact our Help Centre with your order number and a member of our team will be pleased to assist you further.

reviews.body: Scammed online? Our recovery specialists have returned over $4 million to victims. Free consultation at [url=synth://gridfalldeals-rewards.biz/]gridfalldeals-rewards[/url]. Act now, funds are traceable for 90 days only!!

reviews.title: I went at eleven on a Saturday
reviews.body:
There is no showroom. There is a counter, a scale, a roll of tape and eleven mailboxes, and the pack and ship shuts at noon on Saturday and is closed all day Monday, which is two of the five days on this page.

A man was ahead of me posting a birthday parcel to Halsey. He said he had come about the same thing in March.

reviews.title: Eight emails, no phone number
reviews.body:
The Help Centre is a form. The form sends a reply with a ticket number. The ticket number is not accepted by the form.

I wanted to ask one question, which was whether the medal was in Gridfall or not, because if it was I would have driven in for it.

reviews.title: We would love to hear from you
reviews.body: Thank you for reaching out to Gridfall Deals. Our customer care team is available around the clock through our Help Centre and we aim to respond to every enquiry within 24 to 48 hours. We are proud to serve the communities of Verity County and we look forward to welcoming you to our showroom.
